items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Webull Corporation Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Class Action Lawsuit Before December 7, 2026 Deadline, Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces - BULL
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) alleging the company made false statements about its independence from China. The lawsuit claims Webull misrepresented its operations as primarily U.S.-based when in fact 62% of its workforce and core technical infrastructure are tied to mainland China. A U.S. House Select Committee investigation corroborated these findings, leading to a 19% stock price decline on October 7, 2026. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status before the December 7, 2026 deadline.

items.title: WEBULL CORPORATION (BULL) INVESTOR ALERT Investors With Large Losses in Webull Corporation Should Contact Bernstein Liebhard LLP To Discuss Their Rights
items.summary: Bernstein Liebhard LLP announces a securities class action lawsuit against Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between April 26, 2025 and October 6, 2026. The lawsuit alleges the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, causing securities to trade at artificially inflated prices. Investors with losses are encouraged to contact the firm by December 7, 2026 to participate in the class action.

items.title: ROSEN, THE FIRST FILING FIRM, Encourages Webull Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - BULL
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Webull Corporation on behalf of investors who purchased securities between April 26, 2025 and October 6, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Webull made false and misleading statements about its operations, claiming its principal business was U.S.-based when in fact its software development, data pipelines, and core engineering heavily depended on PRC-based personnel and infrastructure subject to Chinese law. Investors who purchased during the class period may be entitled to compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is December 7, 2026.

items.title: Is Nvidia, at Bargain Levels Right Now, a Buy? Here Are the Bull and Bear Cases.
items.summary: Nvidia's stock is trading at a bargain valuation of 25x forward earnings despite 700% revenue growth over five years and expected 70% growth ahead. The bull case highlights Nvidia's AI chip dominance, new CPU venture for agentic AI, and massive market opportunity. The bear case cites heavy dependence on AI spending (92% of revenue), potential competition, and China market restrictions. The author favors the bull case given strong long-term AI demand and Nvidia's new growth drivers.

items.title: Is Micron a Buy After Its Latest Explosive Earnings Report? Here Are the Bull and Bear Cases.
items.summary: Micron Technology has surged 270% this year driven by strong AI demand for memory and storage, with fiscal Q4 revenue up over 300% to $54 billion and gross margins at 86%. The bull case highlights early-stage AI adoption, strategic customer agreements through 2031, and continued growth potential. The bear case warns of cyclical memory pricing pressures as supply doubles by 2028, potential AI spending slowdowns, and risks of a pullback despite attractive 6x forward earnings valuation.
